scenario: Alma 产品工程师面试，招聘人说他们要 full-stack 偏后端，问：「What would you tell me about your background? Have you worked mostly backend?」
scenario_en: In an Alma product-engineer interview the recruiter says they want full-stack leaning backend and asks, "What would you tell me about your background? Have you worked mostly backend?"
q: 你会怎么组织这段「背景」回答？
q_en: How do you structure this "background" answer?
options: Yeah, I'm a full-stack engineer focused on backend, about 70% backend and 30% frontend — I've used Java and PHP, and React on the front...
I've mostly done backend, but honestly nothing too advanced — just regular CRUD services and some maintenance, so I still have a lot to learn.
Mostly backend — about 70%. At TikTok I built the ads campaign APIs for budget and ROI config, and I want to go deeper on backend.
My background is primarily backend, secondarily frontend, at a 70-to-30 split, utilizing Java and PHP in a professional capacity.
options_en: Yeah, I'm a full-stack engineer focused on backend, about 70% backend and 30% frontend — I've used Java and PHP, and React on the front...
I've mostly done backend, but honestly nothing too advanced — just regular CRUD services and some maintenance, so I still have a lot to learn.
Mostly backend — about 70%. At TikTok I built the ads campaign APIs for budget and ROI config, and I want to go deeper on backend.
My background is primarily backend, secondarily frontend, at a 70-to-30 split, utilizing Java and PHP in a professional capacity.
tradeoff: 三拍结构 vs 技术栈流水账：报一串栈省事，代价是没有成果和方向，听不出你多能干。
why: 背景走三拍：现状（角色+范围）→一个带数字的招牌成果→想往哪走。她的真实原话滑进技术栈清单，丢了成果和方向。
why_en: Give a background in three beats — current role and scope, one signature result with a number, and where you want to go — instead of sliding into a tech-stack list.
whenOtherWins: 如果对方明确只想确认「你后端占比多少」这一个事实，那「大概 70% 后端」一句直接回答就够，不必展开三拍。
optionMeanings: 真实原话，滑进技术栈清单。
一味贬低自己的过谦版。
现状+带数字成果+方向三拍。
optionMeanings_en: Her real line — slides into a tech-stack list.
Three beats: now, result with a number, direction.
optionScenarioImpacts: 有栈没成果，听不出你多能干。
三拍下来又清楚又有分量。
生硬像念简历，不像对话。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Stack but no result — they can't tell how good you are.
Undercutting yourself makes them discount you.
Clear and weighty in one pass.
Reads like a resume, not a conversation.
optionDirectness: 只被单问用什么栈时才合适。
只适合书面简历，不适合口头。
optionDirectness_en: Fits only if they asked which stack you use.
Fits a written resume, not speech.

scenario: 一家创业公司电话初面，招聘人开场：「Before we dig in, give me a quick intro — who are you and what do you do?」压力一上来，你的开场句容易语法打结（「I'm a software engineer who now work at TikTok...」）。
scenario_en: On a startup phone screen the recruiter opens, "Before we dig in, give me a quick intro — who are you and what do you do?" Under pressure your opener tends to knot up ("I'm a software engineer who now work at TikTok...").
q: 这个开场「快速自我介绍」，你会怎么说？
q_en: For this opening "quick intro," what do you say?
options: I'm a software engineer who now work at TikTok, right now, and I, TikTok, I do the ads stuff...
Sure — I'm a backend engineer at TikTok on the ads platform. Before that, Meta. I'm looking to own a product end-to-end.
So, um, I'm a software engineer, I've been doing this around four years now, I was at Meta and now TikTok, and I do a bunch of backend things, mostly ads but other stuff too, yeah...
I am a software engineer. I currently work at TikTok. I previously worked at Meta. I have four years of experience.
options_en: I'm a software engineer who now work at TikTok, right now, and I, TikTok, I do the ads stuff...
Sure — I'm a backend engineer at TikTok on the ads platform. Before that, Meta. I'm looking to own a product end-to-end.
So, um, I'm a software engineer, I've been doing this around four years now, I was at Meta and now TikTok, and I do a bunch of backend things, mostly ads but other stuff too, yeah...
I am a software engineer. I currently work at TikTok. I previously worked at Meta. I have four years of experience.
tradeoff: 练熟的三拍 vs 临场语法打结：不练主干句临场发挥，代价是压力一来时态就乱、第一印象散掉。
why: 开场走三拍：现在→一个招牌点→想找什么。压力下最容易「now work」这类时态错，练熟主干句开口才不打结。
why_en: Keep the intro to three clean beats — now, one signature point, and what you want — and drill the main clause so pressure doesn't knot your grammar.
whenOtherWins: 如果对方明说「一句话就好，后面细聊」，那只报「TikTok 后端工程师」一句也够，不必展开三拍。
optionMeanings: 真实原话，时态打结又打转。
现在→招牌点→想找什么三拍。
四年经历全倒出来的啰嗦版。
一句一顿的机械清单版。
optionMeanings_en: Her real line — tense knots, circles.
Three beats: now, one signature point, what you want.
Dumps four years all at once.
optionScenarioImpacts: 语法一乱，开场第一印象就散。
信息太多，对方抓不住重点。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Tangled grammar wrecks the first impression.
Three clean beats — steady from the first word.
Too much info, they miss the point.
Reads like a list, no conversation.
optionDirectness: 正好接住「快速自我介绍」。
只有对方要完整背景时才合适。
optionDirectness_en: Fits only if they want full background.
